definition.zh-TW:
投資活動裡，不屬於取得非流動資產或放貸的其他現金流出，例如買進長期投資或支付保證金給別人。

課程模板保留這一列給零星的投資支出；本課故事沒有用到。
definition.en:
Other investing outflows that are neither payments to acquire non-current assets nor loans advanced, such as buying long-term investments or paying a deposit to another party.

The course template keeps this line for miscellaneous investing payments; the course story does not use it.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表投資活動區的第三列。金額一律是流出，所以列名帶 (-)。實驗室預設隱藏，展開時標示「本課未使用」。
example.en: Where it sits: the third line of investing activities in the statement of cash flows. The amount is always an outflow, hence the (-) in the label. The lab hides it by default and marks it as not used in this course.

misconception.zh-TW: 把不知道怎麼分類的支出全部丟進這一列。本課把付利息、付稅列在營業活動，還借款列在籌資活動；這一列只收真正屬於投資性質的其他流出。
misconception.en: Dumping any hard-to-classify payment here. In this course interest and tax payments are operating and loan repayments are financing; this line only takes other outflows that are genuinely investing in nature.
